== Title ==
<span lang="ja">物資の不足</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-255o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">敵が手札を２枚以下しか持っていない時に使う。敵は即座に２フォース（こちらのターンなら４フォース）を失う。敵が宇宙船に「融合ジェネレータ供給タンク」を乗せている場合、失うフォースは２減る。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">帝国は各種資源を軍の統制下においている。倹約につとめる反乱軍だが、補給士官たちが必死で蓄えた緊急用備蓄を吐き出さざるを得ない。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Shortage of Supplies.

'''Card text:''' Use when the opponent has no more than two cards in hand. They immediately lose 2 Force, or 4 if it is your turn. If the opponent has Fusion Generator Supply Tanks aboard a starship, reduce the loss by 2.

'''Lore:''' The Empire puts resources under military control. The Rebels try to economize, but must draw on emergency reserves their supply officers struggled to build up.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 5
* '''Printed subtype:''' Lost Interrupt

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
